newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends higher on increased demand.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends higher on increased demand.

text.p: Tin price ended six cents higher at 14.88 ringgit ($5.94) a kg after a higher London market prompted buying from overseas, traders said.

"There were some buying interest in Europe, Japanese and local players," a trader said. Turnover was 126 tonnes against 102 on Wednesday. The near-term trend depends a lot on the performance of the London market, they said.
The price differential over London was at $30 a tonne premium against $35 previously. ---Tan Lee Lee (603-230-8911)($1=2.5050 rgt).
